rows.label: Mémoire
rows.value:
Supports Dual Channel DDR4 1866/ 2133/ 2400/ 2667

* DDR4 - 2667 only for Ryzen CPU.
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for Memory support list.

rows.value:

Supports x8 lanes with AMD Ryzen with Radeon Vega Graphics processors.

* Note: PCIe 4.0 speed only for AMD Ryzen 3rd Gen Matisse.
